answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the zephyr of free entry disappears, the tide of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the atlas case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. The result is that sybils must outspend the network they are attacking,.
